summary: The that i have developed with my team emphasizes the problem which had recently been happening right now in which this years disaster is way worse than time so for that i have developed a website which helps to solve those problems easily.
details: People can use our website easily because it works just like a simple car dashboard that requires zero scientific background to navigate. At the top of the page, anyone can glance at four clear vital-sign numbers (+1.47 °C warming, 432 ppm CO₂, 91% ocean heat, and +7% air moisture) to understand the global crisis in five seconds, then click simple filter buttons to explore how it affects Natural Habitats, the Indian Subcontinent, or Human Civilization. From there, users simply tap individual NASA satellite buttons (like MODIS, GPM, AIRS, or OMI) like TV channels to see in plain English what each instrument tracks, and move an interactive Mathematical Trend slider to visually watch unpredictable weather turn into clear, calculated early-warning forecasts.
